lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਿਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukamee srisat saajeean bahu bhit sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: By His Command, He created the creation, the world with its many species of beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa hukam na jaapee ketaRaa sache alakh apaaraa ||
lines.translation: I do not know how great Your Command is, O Unseen and Infinite True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa no too mel laihi gur sabad beechaaraa ||
lines.translation: You join some with Yourself; they reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach rate se niramale haumai taj vikaaraa ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the True Lord are immaculate and pure; they conquer egotism and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis too melahi so tudh milai soee sachiaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: He alone is united with You, whom You unite with Yourself; he alone is true. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਸੂਹਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohaveee soohaa sabh sa(n)saar hai jin duramat doojaa bhaau ||
lines.translation: O red-robed woman, the whole world is red, engrossed in evil-mindedness and the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਜਿਉ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi jhooth sabh binas jaai jiu tikai na birakh kee chhaau ||
lines.translation: In an instant, this falsehood totally vanishes; like the shade of a tree, it is gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਲੋ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਜੀਠ ਸਚੜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh laalo laal hai jiu ra(n)g majeeth sachaRaau ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is the deepest crimson of crimson, dyed in the permanent color of the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਲਟੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ulatee sakat sivai ghar aaee man vasiaa har a(n)mrit naau ||
lines.translation: She turns away from Maya, and enters the celestial home of the Lord; the Ambrosial Name of the Lord dwells within her mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak balihaaree gur aapane jit miliai har gun gaau ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to my Guru; meeting Him, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohaa ra(n)g vikaar hai ka(n)t na paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The red color is vain and useless; it cannot help you obtain your Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਲਹਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: is lahade bilam na hovaee ra(n)d baithee doojai bhaai ||
lines.translation: This color does not take long to fade; she who loves duality, ends up a widow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਦੁੰਮਣੀ ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਲੋੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)dh iaanee du(n)manee soohai ves loubhaai ||
lines.translation: She who loves to wear her red dress is foolish and double-minded.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad sachai ra(n)g laal kar bhai bhaai seegaar banaai ||
lines.translation: So make the True Word of the Shabad your red dress, and let the Fear of God, and the Love of God, be your ornaments and decorations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿ ਚਲਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sadaa sohaaganee j chalan satigur bhaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, she is a happy soul-bride forever, who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape aap upaaian aap keemat paaee ||
lines.translation: He Himself created Himself, and He Himself evaluates Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis daa a(n)t na jaapaee gur sabad bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: His limits cannot be known; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is understood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu gubaar hai doojai bharamaaee ||
lines.translation: In the darkness of attachment to Maya, the world wanders in duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੑੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh thaur na paainhee phir aavai jaaee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest; they continue coming and going.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਸਭ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai sabh chalai rajaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases Him, that alone happens. All walk according to His Will. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohai ves kaaman kulakhanee jo prabh chhod par purakh dhare piaar ||
lines.translation: The red-robed bride is vicious; she forsakes God, and cultivates love for another man.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਸੀਲੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: os seel na sa(n)jam sadaa jhooth bolai manamukh karam khuaar ||
lines.translation: She has neither modesty or self-discipline; the self-willed manmukh constantly tells lies, and is ruined by the bad karma of evil deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis poorab hovai likhiaa tis satigur milai bhataar ||
lines.translation: She who has such pre-ordained destiny, obtains the True Guru has her Husband.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਧਰੇ ਗਲਿ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohaa ves sabh utaar dhare gal pahirai khimaa seegaar ||
lines.translation: She discards all her red dresses, and wears the ornaments of mercy and forgiveness around her neck.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਐ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: peeeai saahurai bahu sobhaa paae tis pooj kare sabh saisaar ||
lines.translation: In this world and the next, she receives great honor, and the whole world worships her.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਰਲਾਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: oh ralaaee kisai dee naa ralai jis raave sirajanahaar ||
lines.translation: She who is enjoyed by her Creator Lord stands out, and does not blend in with the crowd.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh sadaa suhaaganee jis avinaasee purakh bharataar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is the happy soul-bride forever; she has the Imperishable Lord God as her Husband. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਿਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਗੇ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohaa ra(n)g supanai nisee bin taage gal haar ||
lines.translation: The red color is like a dream in the night; it is like a necklace without a string.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa ra(n)g majeeth kaa guramukh braham beechaar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs take on the permanent color, contemplating the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prem mahaa rasee sabh buriaaeeaa chhaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, with the supreme sublime essence of the Lord's Love, all sins and evil deeds are turned to ashes. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jag aap upaaion kar choj vidaan ||
lines.translation: He Himself created this world, and staged this wondrous play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch dhaat vich paaeean mohu jhooth gumaan ||
lines.translation: Into the body of the five elements, He infused attachment, falsehood and self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavai jaai bhavaaeeai manamukh agiaan ||
lines.translation: The ignorant, self-willed manmukh comes and goes, wandering in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa aap bujhaaion guramukh har giaan ||
lines.translation: He Himself teaches some to become Gurmukh, through the spiritual wisdom of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat khajaanaa bakhasion har naam nidhaan ||4||
lines.translation: He blesses them with the treasure of devotional worship, and the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohaveee soohaa ves chhad too taa pir lagee piaar ||
lines.translation: O red-robed woman, discard your red dress, and then, you shall come to love your Husband Lord.
